text: ハーバーシティは試合残りわずかの時間で作戦を変え、相手にもっとプレッシャーをかけて、直接的に攻めるようにしました。これにより、ボールを持つ時間は増えましたが、まだシュートにはつながっていません。3-2と惜しくもリードを奪われている中での粘り強い戦いです[#1884]。

trace.output: Brief: Harbour City change approach for fan audience in ja

- Harbour City increased press from 0.6 to 0.78 to chase the game [#1884].
- Directness of play was raised from 0.28 to 0.43 in the tactical change [#1884].
- Line height increased from 0.62 to 0.74 after the change [#1884].
- Possession pct rose from 31.7% before to 40.8% after change [#1884].
- Score at change was Harbour City 2, Seabrook Town 3 [#1884].

- Harbour City, trailing 2-3, altered their tactics very late in the game (90+2’) by increasing their pressing intensity, line height, and directness to aggressively chase an equalizer [#1884].
- This tactical shift reflects moving away from their usual patient short passing style within a 4-2-3-1 formation towards a higher press and quicker forward play to regain possession higher up and create more immediate attacking chances.
- The rise in pressing (from 0.6 to 0.78) and line height (0.62 to 0.74) indicates Harbour City pushed their defensive line further up the pitch to squeeze Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 setup, aiming to force turnovers in advanced areas and launch direct attacks.
- Although this increased pressure improved their possession (31.7% to 40.8%) and involvement in the opponent’s half, they still failed to generate shots or expected goals, suggesting Seabrook’s wide, crossing-based 3-4-3 countermeasures effectively contained the late surge.
